Workbench, sparse hanging tools and spare wheels behind, dark ink navy architectural shadows and ivory floor. Entire scene is refined semi-realistic 2D editorial illustration, not photography, not 3D. Left 34 percent is solid ink navy #101923. Large condensed ivory AUTOMOTIVE EMPIRE title at upper left. ONE gold filled primary CONTINUAR button with dark text, ONE outlined ivory NUEVA PARTIDA button immediately below, each with generous padding and readable 24px-equivalent text. Small ivory gear icon at bottom left. Correct previous concepts: NO English subtitle, NO proposal labels, NO extra words, no tiny annotations; primary action MUST be filled gold #D8B16A and visually dominant, title cannot touch screen edges. 1920x1080 composition with minimum 64px outer margin, crisp flat UI over rich illustrated backdrop, subtle shadow below car. All wheels and body fit comfortably. Immersive videogame menu, no corporate dashboard or charts.

Avoid cartoon proportions, avoid overly simplified shapes, avoid flat icon style, avoid exaggerated outlines, avoid messy painterly rendering.
The illustration should look like a polished collectible car card asset for a premium tycoon game.
Keep the car isolated, with no environment, no text, no extra objects.
